query:
SELECT e.nomeDoEquipamento, cc.nome as conta, SUM(lc.valor) as total
FROM lancamento_custo lc
JOIN conta_custo cc ON lc.contaCustoId = cc.id
LEFT JOIN equipamentos e ON lc.equipamentoId = e.id
WHERE lc.periodoCustoId = 60001 AND lc.equipamentoId IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY e.id, e.nomeDoEquipamento, cc.nome
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 20;
